contract: An installed published SDK client starts an original parent before worker registration. A parent-only worker schedules one original child on a separately served queue and exits at the waiting checkpoint. A distinct child-only SDK process completes that child once with its exact int64, Unicode and null Avro arguments. A cold parent-only replacement replays the committed result and completes the original parent. Preserve full parent and child history prefixes, original call/link/child instance/run relationships, exact typed arguments/results, selected queues and registered types, actual claims and recorded completion receipts. Embedded executes canonical PHP definitions and explicitly labels language SDK transport inapplicable; its extra child StartAccepted event is retained and checked. Default abandon policies apply. Namespaced children, retries, failures, cancellation propagation, other parent-close policies, parallel groups, activities and performance remain separate gates.
